qualification.details: Manager - Human Resources (NHM): Master's degree in Human Resources Management/Healthcare Management/Public Health from a recognized University/Institution. Preference shall be given to candidates with a Master's in HRM and PG in Public Health with 2 years of relevant experience. Manager - Referral Services (NHM): PG/PGDM in Hospital Administration/Health Management/Operations/Public Health from a recognized University/Institution with 2 years of relevant experience, preferably in managing Emergency Response Systems. Manager - BEMMP & Infrastructure Programs (NHM): B.E./B.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering with 2 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field OR B.E./B.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering along with a Master's Degree/PG Diploma in Management/Hospital Administration with 2 years of post-qualification experience. State Law Officer (NHM): LLB from recognized Institute with Minimum 2 years' experience in Govt or Private sector in relevant field.

content_sections.heading: NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Manager - Human Resources (NHM): Master's degree in Human Resources Management/Healthcare Management/Public Health from a recognized University/Institution. Preference shall be given to candidates with a Master's in HRM and PG in Public Health with 2 years of relevant experience. Manager - Referral Services (NHM): PG/PGDM in Hospital Administration/Health Management/Operations/Public Health from a recognized University/Institution with 2 years of relevant experience, preferably in managing Emergency Response Systems. Manager - BEMMP & Infrastructure Programs (NHM): B.E./B.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering with 2 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field OR B.E./B.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering along with a Master's Degree/PG Diploma in Management/Hospital Administration with 2 years of post-qualification experience. State Law Officer (NHM): LLB from recognized Institute with Minimum 2 years' experience in Govt or Private sector in relevant field.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NHM Ladakh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nhmladakh.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are for various managerial and officer posts within the National Health Mission Ladakh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Manager posts in NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary for the Manager posts in NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026 ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. They include Master's degrees in HRM, Healthcare Management, Public Health, PG/PGDM in Hospital Administration, B.E./B.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering, and LLB, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for NHM Ladakh Recruitment 2026 typically involves evaluating Academic Qualification, Relevant Experience, and a Viva-Voce (interview).
